name: Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract
speaker: entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract
lines: Oh, a human? Far from home aren't we?
Oh, here? Well, first I disposed of my mutinous squad, now I'm searching for the City.
Hmm, yes. It's always such a shame when the greed of foolish men overcomes their survival instincts. I suppose they just weren't meant to reach the City.
Oh you don't know? This tower sits atop New Kyrsa, the Sleeping City. There lies the so-called bedchambers of the Drowned God [Ethiron](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye). Together perhaps we could -
You don't belong here kid, falling for the oldest trick in the book... I'll make quick work of this.

How strange... Time truly does run amok when drawn into [Ethiron's](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye) Wake. To have memories of a previous encounter, yet to be standing here now... Fascinating, isn't it?
This close to the Drowned God [Ethiron](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye), time itself is drawn into the Gale. The natural rules of causality, of cause and effect, all start to fray at the seams.
Again? It hasn't happened yet. Not in my time. There's still time left to talk this through, no? Tell me. After we met in your time, did you make it to the-
Aha, the first strike? Not one to mince words are we?
Ha? Really?! Gods below, you really are such a FOOL.
